fields.description: Item DocType fieldname whose value should be forwarded to Shopware (e.g. 'include_in_idealo_feed', 'include_in_google_shopping'). Must be an existing field on Item — usually a Custom Field added via Customize Form.
fields.label: Item Field

fields.description: Shopware product customField key the value is written to (e.g. 'idealo_feed', 'google_shopping_feed'). The customField slot must exist in Shopware (Settings → System → Custom Fields) and be assigned to the product entity, otherwise Shopware accepts the value into the JSON column but the storefront / product-stream filters won't see it.
fields.label: Shopware Custom Field

fields.description: How to coerce the Item field value before sending. Boolean forces true/false (useful for Check fields driving Shopware product-stream filters). Text passes the value as-is. Integer / Float convert. Skip-If-Empty suppresses the customField entirely when the Item field is empty / null / 0 (use when the absence of a value is meaningful, e.g. an optional URL).
fields.label: Field Type
